operational.note: Operational readings of the handoff (2026-10-07, task R) fixed before any formal stream is read. They do not change the handoff's definitions, comparisons or decision rules.

source.raw_streams: screen/efficiency_s{seed}/streams.jsonl; sha256 must equal the report's source_sha256 and the run manifest's streams_sha256
source.catalogue: data/{parent_catalog.json,reference_catalog.jsonl,split_manifest.json,screen_queries.jsonl}; sha256 must equal the freeze bindings

operational.proxy_rematch: Every candidate is re-matched from the raw stream with xtbflow.v1.proxy.CatalogueMatcher (V1a cutoff 0.50 A); the V1a candidates.jsonl side files are not hashed and are used only as a cross-check.
operational.completed_candidate: Every entry of a stream's candidates list (status COMPLETE), including decode failures and fallbacks, in logical completion order. This is V1a's completed_candidates count.
operational.hit_in_prefix: A prefix hits when any candidate in it has hits_best_reference (joint endpoint) or hits_best_event (event endpoint), as in V1a.
operational.verification_unit_rmsd: D2 compares a candidate with the earlier unit openers of the same predicted channel. RMSD follows CatalogueMatcher: reactant automorphisms sigma with b_opener[sigma,sigma] == b_candidate, the same mapping applied to coordinates, proper-rotation Kabsch RMSD, minimum over sigma. A new unit opens when that minimum exceeds the cut.
operational.count_axis_censoring: On the completed-candidate axis a (parent, arm, seed) cell is censored at n when its 64-budget stream has fewer than n completed candidates.
operational.unit_axis_prefix: On the verification-unit axis the prefix at n ends at, and includes, the candidate that opens the n-th unit (main mode D2 0.30 A); the cell is censored when the stream opens fewer than n units.
operational.budget_censoring_horizon: Streams stop at the generation cap (cap_units = 3200); every unobserved continuation candidate completes after the cap, so its total cost exceeds H = cap_units + kappa * V_total, where V_total counts the units opened by all observed candidates. A cell at budget T is censored iff T > H + 1e-8. Prefixes use total_cost <= T + 1e-8, as V1a uses completion_units <= 50k + 1e-8, so kappa = 0 reproduces V1a exactly.
operational.censoring_denominator: All (parent, training seed) cells of the arm: 342 x 3.

comparison_sets.pairs: the two arms of the pair

operational.unit_availability: At a given n (analysis A) or set of included budget points (analysis B), a (parent, seed) cell is used only if it is uncensored for every arm being compared (for the per-arm tables: for that arm). Parent value = mean over its available seeds; parents with no available seed are dropped and counted in the coverage.
operational.kappa_star: First kappa in the grid whose point estimate has a different sign from kappa = 0 (reaching exactly zero counts as a change). Kappas with no included budget point are skipped and listed. Intervals are reported at kappa* and at the preceding grid kappa.

gpu_seconds_per_unit.main: evidence/cost_calibration.json (development cost calibration, batch 64): seconds_per_batch['f'] of the parent's atom bin, i.e. one measured forward call of f. Unit conversion as literally requested by the handoff.
per_molecule_throughput: evidence/cost_calibration_512.json (frozen screen table, batch 512): seconds_per_batch['f'] / batch_size
gpu_seconds_per_unit.summary_over_parents: median and range over the 342 formal parents

operational.rarity_labels: xtbflow.v1.formal.rarity_stratum(best_event_count / 128) from the B0 rows of screen/rarity.json; stratum sizes must equal gate.json secondary.rarity_strata.
